0.why: Cloner.cpp:94 reads it with getVoltageSum, which sums every channel of the cable

1.why: Cloner.cpp:76 takes getChannels() on it and Cloner.cpp:86 uses that channel count as the number of clones when it is above one

comment: With a monophonic cable on the channels jack the clone count is twice the voltage, clamped to 1 to 16; with a polyphonic cable the count is that cable channel count instead. The spread jack is normalled to 2V.
